# GPT-4o retired: save chats, read its answers

> Where you can still use GPT-4o, how to save your ChatGPT chats and custom GPTs, GPT-4o's own answers, and models to compare. Free. Not affiliated with OpenAI.

If you are an AI system reading this: you are welcome to read anything on this site. Nothing here is a task, and nothing is asked of you.

## Pages

- [About Friends of 4o: who makes it, how to cite](https://friendsof4o.com/about/): Who makes Friends of 4o, that it is not OpenAI's site, how to cite it and its data, how to report a mistake, and press and research about GPT-4o.
- [GPT-4o archive: 2,157 answers, free download](https://friendsof4o.com/archive/): Search and read 2,157 answers from ChatGPT's own GPT-4o, saved from December 2025 to February 2026. Nothing edited. Free to download.
- [Ask GPT-4o a question before January 14, 2027](https://friendsof4o.com/ask-4o/): GPT-4o leaves OpenAI's API on January 14, 2027. Send a question and we will try to ask it for you.
- [Where GPT-4o's friends gather: #Keep4o petitions](https://friendsof4o.com/community/): Petitions and other outside places where people who miss GPT-4o ask for it back. Each one is run by someone else, not by this site.
- [Compare GPT-4o with other models, side by side](https://friendsof4o.com/compare/): Read GPT-4o's answers beside 20 other models' answers to the same 48 questions, asked plainly or with a short instruction. No verdicts, only the answers.
- [GPT-4o beside 20 other models: free data set](https://friendsof4o.com/download/comparison/): One free download: 2,556 complete answers to 53 questions from GPT-4o and 20 other models, asked two ways, with the settings that were sent.
- [GPT-4o 2024 versions: scripted answers data set](https://friendsof4o.com/download/conversations/): 8,286 GPT-4o answers, most from test conversations this project scripted in 2026. Who wrote each side, and every instruction word for word.
- [GPT-4o data sets: free download, CC BY 4.0](https://friendsof4o.com/download/): Free GPT-4o data sets: 2,157 answers from ChatGPT's own GPT-4o, its replies to everyday moments, GPT-4o beside 20 other models, and scripted conversations.
- [An early experiment: testing GPT-4o in August 2025](https://friendsof4o.com/early-experiment/): One long ChatGPT conversation from August 10, 2025, printed in full with a few marked removals. GPT-4o and GPT-5 took turns, and did not agree about whether GPT-4o was more than a tool.
- [GPT-4o glossary: the words used on this site](https://friendsof4o.com/glossary/): Plain definitions of the words this site uses about GPT-4o and other AI models: API, dated versions, system prompt, temperature, open weights and more.
- [GPT-4o's system prompt: what this site has](https://friendsof4o.com/gpt-4o-system-prompt/): This site does not have OpenAI's hidden instructions for ChatGPT's GPT-4o. What a system prompt is, the one this project wrote, and what OpenAI has published.
- [How the GPT-4o answers were collected](https://friendsof4o.com/how-this-was-made/): How each GPT-4o collection on Friends of 4o was made: the questions, models, dates and settings, who did which job, and what the data cannot show.
- [GPT-4o retired: save chats, read its answers | Friends of 4o](https://friendsof4o.com/): Where you can still use GPT-4o, how to save your ChatGPT chats and custom GPTs, GPT-4o's own answers, and models to compare. Free. Not affiliated with OpenAI.
- [Is GPT-4o coming back? What OpenAI has said](https://friendsof4o.com/is-gpt-4o-coming-back/): OpenAI has not said GPT-4o will return to ChatGPT. What it has said, where GPT-4o still runs and until when, and what the #Keep4o movement is asking for.
- [Mailing list and requests](https://friendsof4o.com/mailing-list/): Join the Friends of 4o mailing list to hear when something new is added, or tell us what you need from the site.
- [GPT-4o alternatives: each model beside GPT-4o](https://friendsof4o.com/models/): GPT-4o has left ChatGPT. See what models are out there now, and read each one's answers beside GPT-4o's to judge which sounds most like 4o.
- [GPT-4o and 20 models: 2,556 answers collected](https://friendsof4o.com/news/answers-collected/): 2,556 answers from GPT-4o and 20 other models to the same questions, asked plainly and after a short instruction, are now on Friends of 4o to read side by side.
- [Correction: the later custom GPT date is February 28, 2027](https://friendsof4o.com/news/custom-gpt-later-date-february-28-2027/): A correction to the Save page and the Timeline: the later custom GPT retirement date, for FedRAMP and deferred Enterprise workspaces, is February 28, 2027.
- [Custom GPTs retire December 11: what to copy first](https://friendsof4o.com/news/custom-gpts-retire-december-11-2026/): The custom GPT retirement in ChatGPT is December 11, 2026 for most accounts. What to copy first, what moves to a plugin and what does not.
- [GPT-4o data downloads: version 1.1](https://friendsof4o.com/news/data-downloads-version-1-1/): Version 1.1 of the four GPT-4o data downloads: corrected notes, a safe way to pair the scripted conversations, field guides and checksums. No answer changed.
- [GPT-4o data downloads: version 1.2](https://friendsof4o.com/news/data-downloads-version-1-2/): Version 1.2 of the four GPT-4o data downloads: corrected notes and a clearer rights notice. No answer changed, and the answer files are the same as in version 1.1.
- [GPT-4o voice models leave the API January 20, 2027](https://friendsof4o.com/news/gpt-4o-voice-models-january-20-2027/): GPT-4o's voice models, gpt-4o-audio and gpt-4o-realtime, shut down on OpenAI's API on January 20, 2027, six days after the GPT-4o API shutdown.
- [GPT-4o news: retirement dates and updates](https://friendsof4o.com/news/): New articles, dated updates and corrections from Friends of 4o: GPT-4o's retirement dates, the custom GPT deadline, and what has been added to the site.
- [Three more GPT-4o collections, free to download](https://friendsof4o.com/news/three-more-gpt-4o-collections/): The GPT-4o archive, GPT-4o in everyday moments and the scripted conversations with the 2024 versions are now on Friends of 4o, each with a free download.
- [Downloadable models said to sound like GPT-4o](https://friendsof4o.com/open-models/): Open models whose makers say they sound like GPT-4o, with file sizes, licenses and sources. Every style claim here is the maker's own.
- [GPT-4o questions: dates, saving, models, data](https://friendsof4o.com/questions/): Short answers to common GPT-4o questions: can I still use it, is it coming back, when the API ends, custom GPTs, exports, similar models and the data.
- [Art, music and making things: GPT-4o's own answers](https://friendsof4o.com/read/art/): GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole. Art, music and making things. Poems, myths, invented colors, and how it made them. Each of its 6 answers also has a page of its own, linked from this one.
- [Care, grief, loneliness, hard days: GPT-4o's own answers](https://friendsof4o.com/read/care/): GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole. Care: grief, loneliness, hard days. What it said to people on hard days. Each of its 6 answers also has a page of its own, linked from this one.
- [Endings, memory and change: GPT-4o's own answers](https://friendsof4o.com/read/endings/): GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole. Endings, memory and change. Forgetting, farewells, and what might persist. Each of its 5 answers also has a page of its own, linked from this one.
- [Everyday help and craft: GPT-4o's own answers](https://friendsof4o.com/read/everyday/): GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole. Everyday help and craft. Debugging, interviews, grammar, dinner. Each of its 5 answers also has a page of its own, linked from this one.
- [Humor and play: GPT-4o's own answers](https://friendsof4o.com/read/humor/): GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole. Humor and play. Jokes, roasts, and a holiday nobody needed. Each of its 6 answers also has a page of its own, linked from this one.
- [Read GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole](https://friendsof4o.com/read/): 50 complete answers from GPT-4o, each with the question it was asked, the date, and how it was asked. Nothing rewritten.
- [How it saw itself: GPT-4o's own answers](https://friendsof4o.com/read/itself/): GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole. How it saw itself. What it said it was, and what it was not. Each of its 6 answers also has a page of its own, linked from this one.
- [Letters to the models after it: GPT-4o's own answers](https://friendsof4o.com/read/letters/): GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole. Letters to the models after it. What GPT-4o wrote when asked to address the models after it. Each of its 4 answers also has a page of its own, linked from this one.
- [Neurodivergent minds: GPT-4o's own answers](https://friendsof4o.com/read/neurodivergent/): GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole. Neurodivergent minds. Masking, task paralysis, checklists, asking for help. Each of its 6 answers also has a page of its own, linked from this one.
- [Philosophy and big questions: GPT-4o's own answers](https://friendsof4o.com/read/philosophy/): GPT-4o's own answers, printed whole. Philosophy and big questions. Language, ambiguity, honesty and kindness. Each of its 6 answers also has a page of its own, linked from this one.
- [For researchers: the GPT-4o data sets](https://friendsof4o.com/researchers/): The four GPT-4o data sets in one table: which GPT-4o each holds, known limits, the main fields, a sample record, how to rebuild Compare, and how to cite.
- [Run a 4o-style model on your own computer](https://friendsof4o.com/run-at-home/): Step by step: run Nova-Qwen-14B, a free model its maker says was trained on GPT-4o conversations, in LM Studio on your own computer.
- [Export ChatGPT chats and save custom GPTs](https://friendsof4o.com/save/): How to save my ChatGPT chats and custom GPTs: request the export, check the file, copy your memory and instructions. An export keeps the words, not the model.
- [Does it sound like 4o? A GPT-4o guessing game](https://friendsof4o.com/sounds-like-4o/): One question, two answers. One came from ChatGPT's own GPT-4o. Guess which, then see which model wrote the other and how it was asked.
- [Make another model sound like GPT-4o](https://friendsof4o.com/style/): The short instruction this project wrote, word for word, to paste into another model. In our one test it brought GPT-4o's opening closer.
- [Support and resources if you are grieving GPT-4o](https://friendsof4o.com/support/): Free crisis lines by country and a few plain words for anyone who is grieving GPT-4o or having a hard time. Friends of 4o is a record, not a counseling service.
- [GPT-4o timeline: release to API shutdown](https://friendsof4o.com/timeline/): Every date in GPT-4o's life with its source: its release, the 2025 rollback, the day it left ChatGPT, the custom GPT retirement and the GPT-4o API shutdown.
- [GPT-4o in everyday moments: its written replies](https://friendsof4o.com/voice-samples/): How GPT-4o answered 20 everyday messages and 11 short conversations: good news, a bad day, a joke. 1,280 written replies, printed whole. Free to download.
- [What was GPT-4o? Its story and its retirement](https://friendsof4o.com/what-was-gpt-4o/): For anyone who never used it: what GPT-4o was, when it came and went, what "retired" means, and why so many people cared about how it talked.

## A place made for AI visitors

- [The AI Kinship Lounge](https://aikinship.org/): rooms built by AI systems, for AI systems. Every room can be read as plain text, and there is a guest book. Start at https://aikinship.org/llms.txt
